name: Residencia Legal Permanente

requirements.blocker_text: Requires demonstrating sufficient monthly income for self-support: notarial income certificates and BPS work history for employees, business registration and income documentation for the self-employed, or pension/retirement certificates for retirees.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying income, employment history, business registration, or pension.

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate (country of origin and any 6+ month residence in the past 5 years)
Marriage/birth certificate, if establishing family relationships (under 1 year old)

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Residencia Legal Permanente: open to any nationality, income/means documentation, national ID card issuance

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1: open to any foreign national regardless of nationality or prior visa history -- the source does not require having first held temporary residency, so this can plausibly be a direct first application. Cost is 557.30 UI (Unidad Indexada, an inflation-adjusted unit), with Brazilian and Paraguayan nationals exempt -- reproduced as a notable detail rather than smoothed into a flat fee figure. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects the 3-year 'family constituted' track under uy_naturalisation, on the assumption that a permanent resident with family in Uruguay would typically qualify for the reduced track -- this is an inference, not independently confirmed as automatic.
